title: 3 Inch Cabinet Pull Solid Brass | Autumn Sparkle | Cabinet Hardware Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Bring a clean, coordinated look to bathroom cabinets and drawers while improving everyday grip in Autumn Sparkle, which captures the rich, warm tones of fall foliage with subtle shimmer, bringing seasonal warmth year-round. This 3 inch cabinet pull (also called a cabinet handle or drawer pull) is part of a cabinet hardware collection suited to transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Autumn Sparkle transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Durable build: solid brass construction
- Ready to install: mounting hardware included
- Finish flexibility: offered in multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 3.9 x 1.6 x 3 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 3 x 3 x 3 in.
- Shipping weight: 1 lb.
- Assembly: assembled in the USA
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
